en.title: Nabla Lab
intro: Nabla Lab is an open, independent, and curiosity-driven research community. We share a passion for science and engineering, value collaboration, and embrace the opportunities and challenges of the AI era.

Founded in 2025, we continue to collaborate across universities on fluid mechanics, computational fluid dynamics and wave–structure interaction, alongside interests in marine engineering, aerodynamics and noise. We also share research methods and experience.

topics.title: Waves and structures
topics.text: Wave loading, gap resonance, fluid–structure interaction and offshore renewable energy.

topics.title: Computation and theory
topics.text: Computational fluid dynamics, theoretical analysis and physics-informed neural networks.

topics.title: Aerodynamics and noise
topics.text: UAV aerodynamics and noise reduction, including problems related to low-altitude flight.

zh.title: Nabla Lab
intro: Nabla Lab 是一个开放、独立、由好奇心驱动的研究共同体。我们对科学与工程怀有共同的热情，珍视合作，也愿意面对人工智能时代的机遇与挑战。
Nabla Lab 成立于 2025 年。我们在不同院校持续开展流体力学、计算流体力学和波浪–结构物作用等方面的合作研究，并关注海洋工程、空气动力学与噪声，也交流研究方法和科研经验。

topics.title: 波浪与结构物
topics.text: 波浪荷载、间隙共振、流固耦合，以及海上可再生能源。

topics.title: 计算与理论方法
topics.text: 计算流体力学、理论分析与物理信息神经网络。

topics.title: 空气动力学与噪声
topics.text: 无人机空气动力学、降噪，以及低空飞行中的相关工程问题。
